item.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow as Ukraine reports new Starshield disruptions

item.title: Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat, first Black senator from state since 19th century
item.description: Scott Colom's victory ends a decades-long Republican hold on one of Mississippi's two Senate seats and marks a historic milestone as the first Black senator from the state since the Reconstruction era. item.title: Israeli airstrike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills six, including surgeon
item.description: An Israeli airstrike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, killed six people and wounded at least 28 others early Thursday, according to Gaza's Health Ministry. item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid affair scandal and FBI probe into alleged Chinese spy ties
item.description: Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has resigned, the company announced Thursday, following revelations that he had two extramarital affairs — one with a woman U.S. authorities believe was a Chinese spy and another with a senior Nvidia executive.
